description: Puerto Rico's marinas, yacht clubs, boatyards and landings as 787daily's sailing hub lists them (/water/sailing/marinas/): each place's specs as its operator, NOAA's Coast Pilot or a listing publishes them (slips, max length, depth, fuel, pump-out, haul-out, repairs, transient berths, power, water, VHF, phone, hurricane notes, the nearest CBP site), with sources and the day they were checked. Use it to find a berth, fuel or a haul-out by area, or a place deep enough for a draft. A spec a place does not publish is absent, never assumed; with minDraftFt, places that publish no depth come back in depthNotPublished, and draftFit 'check' means part of the published range is shallower. Cite the marina's url.

area.description: A region (east, north, south, west, islands, or e.g. 'Fajardo and the east') or a town, e.g. 'Fajardo', 'Ponce'

fuel.description: Places that publish fuel: any, diesel or gas

haulOut.description: true: places with a published haul-out (travel lift, hoist or railway)

minDraftFt.description: The boat's draft in feet: places whose published depth reaches it

name: find_marinas
title: Marinas in Puerto Rico
